svg.title: Figure 12.2 — Orientation Flight Versus Robbing
svg.desc: Side-by-side entrance-flight patterns and behavioural cues that help distinguish normal orientation flights from robbing.
svg.text: Both can look busy; use flight pattern, fighting, wax debris and attempts at cracks before deciding.
Do not close a colony completely without considering ventilation. First remove exposed feed/honey, reduce defendable entrance as appropriate and stop the trigger.
